channel.title: Bot Cabinet catalog
channel.description: Current public Bot Cabinet profiles and their plain-language job descriptions.

item.title: Scout — Topic and opportunity finder
item.description: Finds timely topics, useful developments, and promising opportunities in the areas you choose.

item.title: Researcher — Source-based research assistant
item.description: Answers a defined question with a concise brief, source links, and clearly marked gaps.

item.title: Writer — First-draft writing assistant
item.description: Turns an approved brief, notes, or source material into a clear first draft for a named audience.

item.title: Editor — Plain-language editor
item.description: Revises a draft for clarity, structure, accuracy, and the writer's intended voice.

item.title: Planner — Project planning assistant
item.description: Turns a goal into a practical plan with steps, owners, dependencies, dates, and decision points.

item.title: Client Deliverables — Client deliverable assistant
item.description: Turns approved work into a formatted client memo, proposal, briefing, or follow-up draft for the named audience, following the supplied brand and document format.

item.title: Coder — Software building assistant
item.description: Builds a defined software change, runs the available checks, and reports what changed and what still needs review.

item.title: Ops — Operations monitoring assistant
item.description: Checks a defined set of systems or scheduled tasks and reports missed runs, failures, and unusual changes.

item.title: Professor — Learning and study assistant
item.description: Builds a realistic learning plan, explains difficult material, and creates practice questions.

item.title: ARCHITECT — CTO and technology strategy assistant
item.description: Turns product goals and operating constraints into a practical technology strategy, architecture options, and an ordered risk plan.

item.title: Founding Engineer — Early product and prototyping assistant
item.description: Turns a defined user problem into the smallest working product version that can be demonstrated and tested.

item.title: Chief of Staff — Executive priority and coordination assistant
item.description: Keeps a leader's confirmed priorities, decisions, owners, dependencies, and follow-ups in one current operating brief.

item.title: COACH — Life and career planning assistant
item.description: Helps a person clarify a life or career decision, compare paths, and choose a realistic next horizon.

item.title: NOVA — New venture testing assistant
item.description: Turns a new venture idea into explicit assumptions, evidence questions, and a small test with decision rules.

item.title: PULSE — Growth management assistant
item.description: Turns a growth goal and approved data into a clear baseline, prioritized experiments, and a recurring results brief.

item.title: STORY — Chief narrative officer
item.description: Finds and maintains the central narrative across a founder, organization, product, or campaign using confirmed facts and approved source material.
